title: Timeflow Eels and Potions of Time
text: Eating a Timeflow Eel grants 10 seconds of Time Passage: survive until it ends to return to your starting position, health and hunger. Brew an eel with Awkward Potions for 30-second Potions of Time. Redstone extends this to 1:30, triggering a return every 30 seconds; each return goes to the position recorded when you drank it. Glowstone gives 30 seconds of Time Passage II: return to the starting position with full mana, health and hunger, and fully repaired currently worn and held equipment. Clearing the effect cancels its return; it cannot undo death.
Refreshing or upgrading an active effect preserves its first recorded position and state. Time Passage and Temporal Dislocation maintain independent snapshots and return points.
